# llms.txt for https://www.customwaitlist.com

About:
Custom Waitlist is a powerful no-code tool that lets startups and creators build branded waitlist landing pages with custom domains and signup tracking. Perfect for founders, indie hackers, and product launches.

Highlights:
- Create and customize a landing page with signup form, custom colors, text, theme, images, and logo.
- Embed a tweet by ID directly on the page.
- Assign a unique subdomain or use your own domain.
- Preview landing pages live in desktop or mobile view before publishing.
- Generate and share QR codes for social media promotion.
- Manage waitlist members securely via {domain}/list or {subdomain}.customwaitlist.com/list.
- Edit published pages anytime via {domain}/edit (login required).
- Free to use, with affordable Premium options:
  ✅ Dark theme
  🎨 More theme images
  🌐 Use your own custom domain
  📈 Unlimited waitlist members
  🚫 Remove the animated “CustomWaitlist” badge
  💸 Premium pricing: €4.99/month or €59.88/year

Top pages (most useful first):
- https://www.customwaitlist.com/ — Home: Main customization dashboard to create a new waitlist landing page.
